what_it_shows: HERO BEFORE. Color aerial on Jan 1, 1999 (about 5 months before the move): the striped tower on its ORIGINAL site with surf a stone's throw away, sandbag/groin lines in the water, keepers' quarters at left. A C-130 fills the top half. Portrait 2400x3000.
best_segments: Sentence 2 (why): crop the bottom 55% (tower + surf, drop the plane) for 9:16 and push in from the waves to the tower base. Also the 'old site' frame for the before/after.

best_segments: Hook or sentence 2: slow tilt from the sand up the tower. Crop the black film border and the 'HABS NO. NC-357-6' header.

best_segments: Hook (sentence 1): full-height tower for the 'two-hundred-foot' line, or a cut-out of the tower for the diagram. Crop the border.

best_segments: Hook: start tight on the two people and pull back to the full tower (about 3 s). Crop the border.

credit_line: National Park Service, Cape Hatteras National Seashore (1974 aerial)
what_it_shows: B&W vertical survey frame 'DEC-74 ... M-1156 664' of Cape Point and the shoreline. Top-down, so it can be a base map for the old-site vs new-site diagram; the lighthouse itself is small and hard to pick out. 2400x2397.
best_segments: Diagram background only (desaturate, overlay shoreline + 2,900 ft path). Not a standalone beat.

license: Public domain: NPS staff photo ('NPS/Michael B. Edwards'), posted by the NPS Natural Resources Flickr account; Commons 'Public domain' (U.S. Government work).
what_it_shows: HERO AFTER. Color aerial (19 Nov 2004) of the lighthouse at its NEW site, set back in the maritime forest, with a wide band of beach and surf in the foreground and the keepers' quarters beside it. Portrait 2336x3504, a natural fit for 9:16.
best_segments: Sentence 4 (result): start on the surf at the bottom and tilt or push up to the tower so the distance from the sea reads on screen.

credit_line: National Park Service, Cape Hatteras National Seashore
what_it_shows: RESULT/AFTER. Ground level from the ORIGINAL site: a ring of the old foundation granite blocks in the sand in the foreground, the lighthouse tiny on the horizon at its new site. Only 1024x576.
best_segments: Sentence 4 or the end card: the old ring (where it stood) vs the distant tower (where it went). Low res, so use it small or with a gentle blur plate behind it, or upscale 2x.
